groups.title: Position & attitude (light feeds)
groups.intro: Bandwidth-trimmed navigation feeds produced by the topic simplifier for the comm links. These are the cleanest position/attitude sources in the recording.

rows.desc: Trimmed INS feed from the PHINS: roll, pitch, heading, heave plus alignment/quality statuses and per-receiver GPS fix quality.
Bandwidth-trimmed position feed: latitude, longitude, altitude, COG, SOG (m/s), heading. The recommended position/speed source for analysis — this was the speed input to the fuel-curve refit.
Companion raw/unsmoothed variant of the tracked-target list.
Trimmed tracked-target list (fused AIS/radar/lidar tracks) for the control-centre display.

groups.title: Vehicle status, engine & PLC
groups.intro: Vehicle-machinery truth from the programmable logic controller.

rows.desc: Low-power (electrical economy) mode flag.

Core vehicle state at ~1.6 Hz: thruster RPM (the working RPM source), rudder angle, fuel gauge percentage, DriX mode (docking/manual/auto), clutch position, keel state, e-stop flags (RC / cable / HMI), low-power and emergency modes, PLC error code, shutdown status.
Payload winch status array (position, load, limits).
Remote-controller pendant status: link, buttons, e-stop.

Full PLC telemetry at ~1.3 Hz: engine (oil pressure, coolant/exhaust/gearbox temperatures, hours, load, accelerator), fuel rate (L/h) and total fuel used, compartment temperature/humidity/smoke/water alarms, bilge pumps, battery/alternator electrics, engine diagnostics, sensor-fault flags, sea-water valve, nav light, fog horn. Primary fuel-burn source. Note: shaft_sensor_rpm was faulted throughout these logs — use thruster_rpm from vehicle_status instead.
Extinguisher arming-pin state string.
Fire-extinguisher system status per bottle.
States of the PLC digital output channels (pumps, fans, lights...).
State of each electronic breaker channel (powered equipment switching).
Battery 1/2 voltage, current and charge/discharge flags plus alternator 1/2 current and fault flags.
Channel-name map for the digital outputs (latched).
Channel-name map for the electronic breakers (latched).
Keep-alive that must be published while commanding keel motion. No traffic in these logs.
Installation/sensor offsets currently applied by the PLC (latched).
Name/scaling map for the spare analog telemetry channels (latched).
Legacy PLC telemetry format. No traffic in these logs.
Manual winch up/down commands issued by the operator.

Onboard endurance projection at ~1 Hz: current burn, remaining distance/time to reserve at current speed and at fixed 4/8/12 kt, burn rate at 4/8/12 kt, and whether the dynamic or static model produced it.
Fuel-consumption node health: OK / ERROR / FUEL_LIMIT (raised when only the 20% reserve remains).

Coefficients of the onboard SOG-quadratic burn model (a·v² + b·v + c), tank capacity and reserve floor percentage. Note: this static model reads roughly 1.9× the measured burn for the EM2040 configuration — treat its predictions as very conservative.
Smoothed fuel burn (L/h), published about every 15 s.
Smoothed speed over ground, the companion to average_fuel_rate.
